title: TRY/EXCEPT Error Handling
description: Master error handling with TRY/EXCEPT blocks to build resilient test suites that gracefully handle failures.

story.setup: MENTOR-9: "The ship's systems are unpredictable. Some operations might fail—sensors might timeout, connections might drop. We need error handling to prevent total diagnostic failure when one component fails."
story.context: TRY/EXCEPT blocks allow tests to handle errors gracefully instead of crashing. This is critical for resilient automation in unstable environments.
story.arc: Learn to catch and handle errors, use ELSE and FINALLY blocks, and build robust error-recovery workflows.
